title: Magnetic Snap
description: Khối nhích chậm rồi bị hút vụt vào ô đích, vượt quá một chút rồi bám lại, vòng từ trường loé lên.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio magnetic-snap, written here): x keys 0 → 36 px at 260 ms (sine.inOut) → 192 at 484 ms (power2.in: pulled in, past the slot) → 175 at 620 ms (power2.out) (demo ×1.03). At the snap the block squashes: scaleX 1 − 0.14 s, scaleY 1 + 0.14 s, s a sine bump 440–640 ms. Target: three faint rings brighten with proximity²; one pulse ring 24 → 64 px fades over 470 ms from 484 ms. Params: duration (0.62 s) · x (175 px) · overshoot (17 px) · rings: vòng hút (bật/tắt). Creeps (sine.inOut), is pulled in past the slot (power2.in), settles back (power2.out) with a squash; the slot's rings brighten with proximity² and pulse once.
